experiment: Sixteen full-scale, simple-span (25 ft and 24 ft 8 in.), through-fastened-panel roof assemblies with four cold-formed C-purlin lines (two interior 9x3 test purlins) were loaded to failure in a vacuum chamber under simulated gravity (7 tests) and simulated uplift (9 tests) loading, with varying purlin orientation, shear clips, torsional restraint and intermediate bracing, and the measured failure loads were compared with AISI constrained-bending predictions based on measured cross-section dimensions and tensile coupon properties.
title: Load Tests of Simple-Span Cold-Formed C-Purlin Supported Roof Systems

variables.definition: Test designation number (1-16) identifying each full-scale roof system test, printed in every table.
variables.evidence: Table 1.1 p.7; Table 2.1 p.18; Table 2.2 p.20; Tables 3.1/3.2 pp.26-27; Table 3.3 p.36; Table S1
variables.name: Test number
variables.note: Test 13 printed as '13 **' with an invalid-result footnote; one coupon row is labelled 'Ext'.

variables.definition: Label identifying which of the two interior test purlins (East or West) a measured dimension, computed property or coupon applies to.
variables.evidence: Table 2.1 p.18; Table 2.2 p.20; Table 3.3 p.36
variables.name: Purlin location (East/West)
variables.note: Printed once per pair; repeated on the West row during extraction.

variables.definition: Direction of the simulated load applied by the vacuum chamber (simulated gravity for Tests 1-6 and 16, simulated uplift for Tests 7-15).
variables.evidence: Table 1.1 side heading p.7; Table S1 column load_direction
variables.name: Loading direction

variables.definition: Nominal sheet gage number of the test purlin material (14 gage except Test 5 at 12 gage and Test 6 at 16 gage).
variables.evidence: Table 1.1 p.7; Table S1 column nominal_gage; Table 2.1 header note
variables.name: Nominal purlin gage

variables.definition: Relative orientation of the flanges of the two interior test purlins (Same, Facing or Opposing), defined by sketches at the bottom of Table 1.1.
variables.evidence: Table 1.1 p.7; Table S1 column purlin_orientation
variables.name: Purlin orientation

variables.definition: Whether shear clips were used to connect the purlins to the rafters (Yes/No); Test 1 purlins were bolted directly to the rafters.
variables.evidence: Table 1.1 p.7; Table S1 header note on Test 1
variables.name: Shear clips used

variables.definition: Whether torsional restraint braces were installed at the rafter supports (Yes/No).
variables.name: Torsional restraint at rafters

variables.definition: Location and spacing of intermediate lateral braces along the span (e.g. none, at midspan, at ends and midspan), summarised in the bracing column of Table S1.
variables.evidence: Table 1.1 p.7; Table S1 column bracing
variables.name: Intermediate bracing arrangement

variables.definition: Narrative configuration notes printed in the remarks column of the test matrix and of the gravity/uplift results tables.
variables.evidence: Table 1.1 p.7; Table 3.1 p.26; Table 3.2 p.27
variables.name: Configuration remarks
variables.note: Ditto marks (") mean same as the row above.

variables.definition: Simple-span length of the purlins between supports: 25 ft 0 in. for all tests except Tests 15 and 16 (24 ft 8 in.).
variables.evidence: Table S1 column span_ft; stated in Table 1.1 and Table 2.2 header notes
variables.name: Span length
variables.note: Given as a header note in Tables 1.1 and 2.2, as a column in Table S1.

variables.definition: Number of spans in the test assembly; all tests were simple span (1).
variables.name: Number of spans

variables.definition: Number of parallel purlin lines in each test assembly (four: two interior 9x3 test purlins plus two 7x3 edge purlins).
variables.evidence: Table S1 column n_purlin_lines and header note
variables.name: Number of purlin lines

variables.definition: Purlins were spaced 5 ft 0 in. on center, giving a 5 ft tributary width per purlin line.
variables.evidence: Table S1 header note (purlin spacing/tributary width)
variables.name: Purlin spacing
variables.note: Stated only in a header note, not a column.

variables.definition: Cold-formed cross-section shape of the interior test purlins (C-section with lipped flanges).
variables.name: Section type

variables.definition: Type of roof panel and attachment used over the purlins (nominally 26 gage through-fastened panels).
variables.evidence: Table S1 column panel_type and header note
variables.name: Roof panel type

variables.definition: Roof panels were nominally 26 gage, 2 ft 6 in. wide by 15 ft long, as stated in the summary header note.
variables.evidence: Table S1 header note on roof panels
variables.name: Roof panel gage and size
variables.note: Stated only in a header note.

variables.definition: Panel-to-purlin fasteners were No. 12 x 1 in. self-drilling screws at 15 3/4 in. on center, with sheet-to-sheet fasteners at 30 in. on center.
variables.evidence: Table S1 header note on fasteners
variables.name: Panel fastener spacing
variables.note: Stated only in a header note.

variables.definition: Overall depth of the C-purlin cross section, measured on each test purlin (nominal 9 in.).
variables.evidence: Table 2.1 p.18 column total_depth_in; Table S1 column depth_in
variables.name: Purlin depth

variables.definition: Measured base-metal thickness t of the purlin material, taken on the section and on the tensile coupons.
variables.evidence: Table 2.1 p.18; Table 3.3 p.36; Table S1 column thickness_in
variables.name: Material thickness
variables.note: Test 13 East coupon thickness printed with an illegible digit ('0.07[?]').

variables.definition: Top flange width measured from outside of web to the tangent of the radius (Fig. 2.1).
variables.name: Top flange width

variables.definition: Top lip (stiffener) length from free end of lip to tangent of radius (Fig. 2.1).
variables.name: Top lip length

variables.definition: Inside bend radius between the top lip and the top flange (Fig. 2.1).
variables.name: Top lip-to-flange radius

variables.definition: Inside bend radius between the top flange and the web (Fig. 2.1).
variables.name: Top flange-to-web radius

variables.definition: Measured angle between the top lip and the top flange (Fig. 2.1).
variables.name: Top lip angle

variables.definition: Bottom flange width measured from outside of web to the tangent of the radius (Fig. 2.1).
variables.name: Bottom flange width

variables.definition: Bottom lip (stiffener) length from free end of lip to tangent of radius (Fig. 2.1).
variables.name: Bottom lip length

variables.definition: Inside bend radius between the bottom flange and the web (Fig. 2.1).
variables.name: Bottom flange-to-web radius

variables.definition: Inside bend radius between the bottom lip and the bottom flange (Fig. 2.1).
variables.name: Bottom lip-to-flange radius

variables.definition: Measured angle between the bottom lip and the bottom flange (Fig. 2.1).
variables.name: Bottom lip angle

variables.definition: Gross moment of inertia about the horizontal (bending) axis, computed from the measured cross-section dimensions.
variables.name: Gross moment of inertia

variables.definition: Gross section modulus referred to the top fiber, computed from the measured dimensions.
variables.name: Gross section modulus, top

variables.definition: Gross section modulus referred to the bottom fiber, computed from the measured dimensions.
variables.name: Gross section modulus, bottom

variables.definition: Effective moment of inertia used in the AISI strength calculation (effective width method).
variables.name: Effective moment of inertia (strength)
variables.note: Test 7 West cell printed with an unreadable character ('13.3[?]2').

variables.definition: Effective section modulus referred to the top fiber from the AISI effective-width analysis.
variables.name: Effective section modulus, top

variables.definition: Effective section modulus referred to the bottom fiber from the AISI effective-width analysis.
variables.name: Effective section modulus, bottom
variables.note: Printed under the heading S_t in the strength group.

variables.definition: Effective width of the compression flange (BE) from the AISI analysis, printed in the S_e column.
variables.name: Effective flange width
variables.note: Column heading S_e but the values are an effective width in inches.

variables.definition: Allowable compression stress used in the AISI bending analysis (33.6 ksi, i.e. 0.6 x 56 ksi).
variables.name: Allowable compression stress

variables.definition: Allowable tension stress used in the AISI bending analysis.
variables.name: Allowable tension stress

variables.definition: Allowable bending stress for the web from the AISI analysis.
variables.name: Allowable web bending stress

variables.definition: Allowable moment governed by the compression flange, from the AISI analysis of each purlin.
variables.name: Allowable moment, compression flange

variables.definition: Allowable moment governed by the tension flange, from the AISI analysis of each purlin.
variables.name: Allowable moment, tension flange

variables.definition: Allowable moment governed by the web, from the AISI analysis of each purlin.
variables.name: Allowable moment, web
variables.note: Test 9 East printed as '8.14[?]'.

variables.definition: Governing allowable moment multiplied by the factor of safety (printed as 1.65, 1.67 elsewhere) to give the ultimate moment capacity.
variables.name: Ultimate moment capacity
variables.note: Test 3 East value printed as 13.084, inconsistent with Fig. A.20 (13.439).

variables.definition: Uniform load on the purlin line corresponding to M_u over the test span, computed per purlin.
variables.name: Uniform load at ultimate moment
variables.note: Tests 15 and 16 values printed with unreadable characters.

variables.definition: Moment of inertia used in the deflection calculations for each purlin.
variables.name: Moment of inertia for deflection

variables.definition: Calculated midspan deflection per 100 plf of uniform load on the test span.
variables.name: Deflection per 100 plf
variables.note: Tests 15 and 16 values printed with unreadable characters.

variables.definition: Yield stress of 56 ksi assumed in all AISI capacity calculations, stated in the Table 2.2 description and in the Table S1 notes.
variables.evidence: Table 2.2 description p.20; Table S1 header note on AISI predicted loads
variables.name: Assumed yield stress for AISI calcs
variables.note: Stated in a note, not a column; measured coupon average was 54.0 ksi.

variables.definition: Factor of safety (printed as 1.65 in the Table 2.2 group heading, 1.67 in the appendix printouts and Table S1 notes) removed from the allowable moment to obtain the predicted failure load.
variables.evidence: Table 2.2 column group heading '(1.65*allowable)'; Table S1 header note
variables.name: AISI factor of safety
variables.note: Printed inconsistently as 1.65 and 1.67.

variables.definition: Predicted failure load per purlin line from the AISI constrained-bending criteria with the factor of safety removed and Fy = 56 ksi.
variables.evidence: Table 3.1 p.26; Table 3.2 p.27; Table S1 column aisi_predicted_load_plf
variables.name: AISI predicted failure load
variables.note: Report does not state which test purlin's w_u the single value corresponds to.

variables.definition: Measured ultimate (failure) uniform load per purlin line, equal to the applied vacuum load plus the dead load carried by a test purlin.
variables.evidence: Table 3.1 p.26; Table 3.2 p.27; Table S1 column failure_load_as_printed
variables.name: Measured failure load
variables.note: Test 13 result is not valid (construction error).

variables.definition: Dead load supported by a test purlin that is added to the applied vacuum load to give the reported failure load (e.g. 8.9 plf for Test 1).
variables.evidence: Table S1 header note giving Test 1 as 140.63 plf applied + 8.9 plf dead load
variables.name: Dead load per purlin
variables.note: Only one example value is given in a note.

variables.definition: Ratio of the actual failure load to the AISI predicted (reference) load, printed in parentheses under the failure load.
variables.evidence: Table 3.1 p.26; Table 3.2 p.27; Table S1 column actual_to_predicted_ratio
variables.name: Test-to-predicted load ratio

variables.definition: Description of the observed failure mechanism (e.g. local buckling of the compression flange and/or web of a test purlin).
variables.evidence: Table 3.1 p.26; Table 3.2 p.27; Table S1 column failure_mode
variables.name: Observed failure mode
variables.note: Ditto marks in the printed tables mean same as the row above.

variables.definition: Measured width of the standard tensile coupon cut from each test purlin.
variables.name: Coupon width

variables.definition: Yield stress measured in standard tensile coupon tests on material from the east and west test purlins; the 32-coupon average was 54.0 ksi.
variables.evidence: Table 3.3 p.36 column fy_ksi; Table S1 columns yield_stress_east_ksi and yield_stress_west_ksi
variables.name: Coupon yield stress
variables.note: Test 14 West printed with an illegible last digit; Test 10 West printed as '.57.87'.

variables.definition: Ultimate tensile stress measured in the standard tensile coupon tests.
variables.name: Coupon ultimate stress

variables.definition: Elongation at fracture measured in the standard tensile coupon tests.
variables.name: Coupon elongation
